config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round(quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk']) * 1000, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'] != ''), 0) AS value FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanName LIKE 'chat %' AND ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source'] = 'coding-agent' AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
config.name: TTFT p95 (ms)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 0) AS value FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanName LIKE 'chat %' AND ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source'] = 'coding-agent' AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
config.name: Latency p95 (ms)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, if(SpanAttributes['coding_agent.client.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['coding_agent.client.name'], if(ServiceName LIKE 'codex%', 'codex', ServiceName)) AS agent, count() AS requests, round(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') * 100.0 / count(), 2) AS err_pct, round(quantileIf(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk']) * 1000, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'] != ''), 0) AS ttft_p50_ms, round(quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk']) * 1000, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'] != ''), 0) AS ttft_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 0) AS lat_p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 0) AS lat_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1e6, 0) AS lat_p99_ms, round(if(sumIf(Duration / 1e9 - toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'] != '' AND Duration / 1e9 > toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'])) > 0, sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'] != '' AND Duration / 1e9 > toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'])) / greatest(sumIf(Duration / 1e9 - toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'] != '' AND Duration / 1e9 > toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk'])), 1e-9), 0), 1) AS gen_toks, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])), 0) AS tok_in, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])), 0) AS tok_cache, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens'])), 0) AS tok_cache_write, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])), 0) AS tok_out FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanName LIKE 'chat %' AND ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source'] = 'coding-agent' AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) GROUP BY model, agent ORDER BY requests DESC
